product_summary: Website (kreativeorganics.com/products.html, fetched) lists an API/techpack portfolio: Etodolac (USP/EP/BP/IP/JP), Bisacodyl (USP/EP/BP/IP/JP), Sodium picosulfate (USP/EP/BP), Glipizide (USP/EP/BP/IP), Gliclazide (EP/BP/IP), Methenamine hippurate (USP), Methenamine (USP), Ferric carboxy maltose, Choline salicylate solution (BP), Dextromethorphan HBr (USP/EP/BP/IP), Salsalate (USP), Magnesium salicylate (USP), plus intermediate Ferric chloride hexahydrate. Under development: S(+)-Etodolac, Apixaban, Apalutamide, Abemaciclib, Dabrafenib, Acalabrutinib, Selexipag, Adenosine, Atropine sulfate, Dexmedetomidine HCl, Sucroferric oxyhydroxide, Ferric citrate, Ferric derisomaltose. Company self-describes as 'manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for the world market', operations since 1990, founder Dr. S. Krishnamohan (homepage, fetched).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared API manufacturer with own plant and DMF/CEP filings table on products page; no trader signs found on site — no 'we are trading house', no third-party brand resale). Not independently corroborated by customs lines in this pass.
comment: Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a pharmaceutical API manufacturer (organic fine chemicals / drug substances), not petrochemicals. Correct industry: pharma / fine chemicals (organic synthesis). HS mapping: declared 293339 and 293359 are heterocyclic-compound subheadings — plausible for the heterocycle APIs (Etodolac, Glipizide, Gliclazide, Bisacodyl, Sodium picosulfate, Methenamine hippurate) but at HS-6 the site does not disclose which subheading each product falls under, so exact per-product assignment cannot be verified from public pages; 294200 (organic compounds NEC) is a reasonable catch-all for the iron-carbohydrate complexes and techpack intermediates. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: (a) inorganic/intermediate Ferric chloride hexahydrate (Ch. 28, ~2827), (b) iron-carbohydrate complexes Ferric carboxy maltose / Sucroferric oxyhydroxide / Ferric citrate / Ferric derisomaltose (Ch. 28/29 NEC, not 2933/2934), (c) Choline salicylate (quaternary ammonium salt, ~2923), (d) salicylates Salsalate and Magnesium salicylate (~2918), (e) Dextromethorphan HBr (morphinan derivative, ~2933.49 — arguably covered by 2933 family but not by 293339/293359 specifically). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, codes corrected to the actual product range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product claims are from the company's own website only — no customs line was checked in this pass, therefore every product/HS mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed). Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and shipment records: null — not researched per role scope and not public on the pages read.
